# Efter vinstvarningen – Di-reportern spår stort sparpaket

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-10-02  
**Market Sentiment**: Negative

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The episode covers Volvo Cars' profit warning with Di auto reporter Karin Nordlander. She says the warning was expected after the strategy day and points to China, where sales are down about 40%. Geely ownership has not helped there, EX60 production is struggling, and it is unclear when the new CEO will take over. She expects a large cost-cutting package with job cuts and lower investment plans at the Q3 report on 23 October. The tone is clearly negative, with only a slight hint that China may be close to bottoming.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Profit warning, China sales down 40%, EX60 production problems and an uncertain CEO handover. A cost-cutting package is expected on 23 Oct.

#### Reasoning

Di reporter Karin Nordlander (guest journalist, not a stock recommendation) calls the outlook very dark. China is collapsing and Volvo lacks the right products there. EX60 is ramping far slower than planned. The new CEO only has to start by 1 Oct next year, while Samuelsson's contract ends in April. A large savings package with job cuts and lower investment is likely. The only positive note is that China may be near the bottom.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Q3 report on 23 Oct brings a credible cost programme that markets reward
- if EX60 production problems are resolved and deliveries pick up
- if China sales bottom out and recover
- if the new CEO starts early and gives a clear strategy

> *"Det rullar ut väldigt få EX60 och man har uppenbarligen problem med flera delar i produktionen så att det är ju inte någonting som på nåt sätt stärker bolaget och gör att det ser ljusare ut, utan tvärtom riktigt oroväckande."*
